professionalSummary.text: Data Quality Engineer with 3 years of end-to-end ownership of merchant feed quality for e-commerce fulfilment platforms, including validation decision-making, service development, and cross-functional leadership.

experienceHighlights.text: Decided which feed validations blocked merchant onboarding, signing off on each validation release as the named owner in the data ownership register.

experienceHighlights.text: Built and maintained the feed validation service (Kotlin, deployed with ingestion stack) and per-merchant quality scorecards used by onboarding and support teams.

experienceHighlights.text: Led monthly merchant data quality forums with onboarding and support leads, deciding quality thresholds for new merchant tiers and recording decisions in forum notes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the monthly merchant data quality forum with the onboarding and support leads, deciding the quality thresholds for new merchant tiers and recording the decisions in the forum notes.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated validation changes with onboarding and platform teams through the platform change process, documenting ownership boundaries (platform team owned ingestion stack, onboarding owned merchant communication, candidate owned validations).
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated validation changes with the onboarding and platform teams through the platform change process, recording that the platform team owned the ingestion stack and onboarding owned merchant communication while I owned the validations.
